Now it's time for my yearly ritual (on this blog anyway) talking about how my year has gone. Here's an overview that I suspect by this time next year will turn into a straight-up travel post:

## The Good of 2026

### Travel

This year, I was able to start expanding into international travel and visited the following locations:

- Ottawa
- Ireland & Scotland
- Toronto
- NY State Parks
- Washington

#### Ottawa

Visited for the Winterlude festival in February!

![Ice scupltures](winterlude.jpg)

But also visited the art museum 

![It's a spider.](ottawa_art_museum.jpg)

#### Ireland & Scotland

I took my first international flight this May with a group of friends and my partner! I spent some time in Dublin and then in Edinburgh.

![Dublin's Molly Malone Statue. Got a clear shot of it because our hotel was nearby after a red-eye.](molly_malone.jpg)

![Trinity College, right after opening. It was very peaceful on a Saturday morning.](trinity_college.jpg)

![Dublin's downtown.](dublin.jpg)

We spent some time in Edinburgh, which was more my speed in terms of city size and tourists:

![Arthur's Seat in Holyrood Park. Be careful hiking Arthur's Seat, as it's slippery.](arthurs_seat.jpg)

![Edinburgh Castle, the main attraction of downtown Edinburgh.](edinburgh_castle.jpg)

![The Royal Mile early in the morning. You can see where Diagon Alley's inspiration came from.](royal_mile.jpg)

![Because of going at the end of May, the sun didn't set until 9:30 or so, and it didn't get fully dark (was just twilight late at night).](royal_mile.jpg)

We also did a 14-hour bus tour (do not recommend a bus tour that long) which drove around the main points of Scotland, including the following

![Urquhart Castle with Loch Ness in the background. Surprised how much Loch Ness reminded me of the Finger Lakes, even though I know lochs go much deeper.](loch_ness.jpg)

![Glencoe Valley's mountains.](glencoe_valley.jpg)

#### Toronto

We got lucky hitting Toronto right before a severe heatwave and extreme wildfire smoke. Sometimes it's better to be lucky than to be good.

![Toronto skyline with the CN tower present.](toronto.jpg)

#### NY State Parks

Normally I wouldn't call this out, but I really wanted to show this photo from Letchworth at the end of July.

![They do weekly air balloons at Letchworth State Park; happened to arrive just as it was going over one of the waterfalls before it floated high into the air as we made our way to our cabins.](letchworth_air_balloon.jpg)
